company.name: ToDesktop
company.shortDescription: ToDesktop enables web businesses to convert their web app into a desktop app.
company.description:
ToDesktop enables web businesses to convert their web app into a desktop app.  With ToDesktop users can install web apps to their computer and launch it from the same place as other desktop apps on Windows, Mac, and Linux.

The company was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Cork, Ireland.

productsAndServices.description: A tool that converts web apps into cross-platform desktop apps with native features using a drag-and-drop interface and minimal coding.
productsAndServices.name: ToDesktop Builder

productsAndServices.description: A set of APIs that enable web apps converted with ToDesktop to access native desktop system features and customize app behavior.
productsAndServices.name: ToDesktop Desktop APIs

productsAndServices.description: A platform that handles packaging, publishing, and distributing desktop apps with native installers, auto-updates, and analytics.
productsAndServices.name: ToDesktop Publishing and Distribution Platform

productsAndServices.description: A system for securely signing Debian APT repository manifests on demand using isolated Cloudflare Workers to protect private keys.
productsAndServices.name: Debian APT Repository Support with Dynamic PGP Signing
